sentences.en: We are in commission concerning the protection of children's rights.
sentences.zh: 我们在儿童权益保护方面受委托负责。

sentences.en: The long-awaited commission of enquiry report was released yesterday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 大家期待已久的调查报告昨天下午终于发布了。

sentences.en: I get a three percent commission on anything I sell.
sentences.zh: 我每卖出一件东西都能得到百分之三的佣金。
